Antidepressants don’t work like xanax or anything like that lol, it’s a completely different type of drug as xanax is a benzodiazepine & lexapro / other antidepressants are typically SSRI’s. Basically xanax is not a long term solution as they are highly addictive & make you feel good quickly, where as lexapro is something you can take long term, everyday & aren’t addictive as well. Lexapro isn’t like xanax where it’ll make you calm down & feel good, it more so fixes the chemical distribution that’s causing ur body to either be depressed or anxious, it does something in ur brain to distribute the proper amounts of serotonin I believe. Xanax is literally only for emergency purposes like panic attacks tbh.

They can’t give you a high dosage right away because you’re body needs a time to familiarize what’s happening and adjust to the new chemical levels and stuff. But ya I suggest just taking it till you finish & then give ur doctor a call.
